info.name: Fluxy Mock
info.description:
Collection for fluxy-mock HTTP mock proxy service.

Template variables supported:
- {{uuid}}, {{timestamp}}, {{now}} — built-in generators, seeded once per request and shared across all templates.
- {{path.id}}, {{query.page}} — path/query variables.
- {{uuid:alias}} — named binding: generates a UUID, stores it under 'alias', reusable as {{alias}} in any subsequent template of the same request (body + SQS messages).
- {{timestamp:alias}}, {{now:alias}} — same named-binding pattern for other generators.

Endpoint creation now accepts `mode`: `STATIC_JSON` renders templates, `PROXY` forwards to `targetBaseUrl`, `CAPTURE` caches the first upstream response, and `SECURE_CAPTURE` caches only 2xx upstream responses. Proxy-style modes can also define `responseJsonFieldOverrides` to patch small JSON fields in upstream responses.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Get User by ID",
  "httpMethod": "GET",
  "pathPattern": "/users/{id}",
  "targetBaseUrl": "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com",
  "enabled": true,
  "responses": [
    {
      "description": "Success response",
      "active": true,
      "httpStatus": 200,
      "responseHeaders": { "X-Mock": "true" },
      "bodyTemplate": "{\"id\": \"{{path.id}}\", \"name\": \"John Doe\", \"uuid\": \"{{uuid}}\", \"timestamp\": \"{{timestamp}}\"}",
      "latencyMs": 100,
      "requestMatcher": null,
      "postActions": []
    },
    {
      "description": "Not found response",
      "active": false,
      "httpStatus": 404,
      "responseHeaders": {},
      "bodyTemplate": "{\"error\": \"User {{path.id}} not found\"}",
      "latencyMs": 0,
      "requestMatcher": null,
      "postActions": []
    }
  ]
}

{
  "name": "Update Product",
  "httpMethod": "PATCH",
  "pathPattern": "/products/{id}",
  "targetBaseUrl": "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com",
  "enabled": true,
  "responses": [
    {
      "description": "Product updated",
      "active": true,
      "httpStatus": 200,
      "responseHeaders": {},
      "bodyTemplate": "{\"id\": \"{{path.id}}\", \"updated\": true, \"timestamp\": \"{{now}}\"}",
      "latencyMs": 50,
      "requestMatcher": null,
      "postActions": []
    }
  ]
}

{
  "name": "Delete Item",
  "httpMethod": "DELETE",
  "pathPattern": "/items/{id}",
  "targetBaseUrl": "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com",
  "enabled": true,
  "responses": [
    {
      "description": "Item deleted",
      "active": true,
      "httpStatus": 204,
      "responseHeaders": {},
      "bodyTemplate": null,
      "latencyMs": 0,
      "requestMatcher": null,
      "postActions": []
    }
  ]
}

item.name: Named Variables – Examples
item.description:
Examples illustrating the {{generator:alias}} named binding feature.
A named variable is generated once and shared across the body template and all sqsMessageTemplates of the same request.
